summary: Iteration 32: Testing Portal Documents feature, AI Business Assistant, and Portal login page. All features verified working correctly. Fixed 1 bug in send-to-portal endpoint.

fixed.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when tenant is None
fixed.root_cause: Line 589 in documents.py called tenant.get() without checking if tenant is None first
fixed.fix_applied: Added null check: portal_url = tenant.get('portal_url', ...) if tenant else default_url

tests: Portal login page - PASS (Only 2 tabs: Sign In and Register, no extra buttons)
AI Business Assistant - PASS (Returns context-aware response with actual shop data)
Portal Dashboard login - PASS (Successfully logged in via portal)
Portal Documents tab navigation - PASS (Documents tab visible in portal nav)
Portal Documents page - PASS (Page loads with correct title and empty state message)

ai_business_assistant.details: AI Assistant returns context-aware responses using real shop data (revenue, jobs, customers, etc.)

portal_documents_tab.details: Documents tab appears in portal navigation between Invoices and Messages

portal_documents_endpoint.details: GET /api/portal/documents returns list of documents shared with customer

document_send_to_portal.details: POST /api/documents/{id}/send-to-portal creates portal_document entry and notification

portal_login_page.details: Only 2 tabs visible (Sign In, Register) - no extra buttons. Submit button is inside form.

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed null check in documents.py line 589 for tenant.get() call
Portal navigation correctly includes Documents tab
AI Assistant uses real shop data via get_shop_context() function
seed_data_creation: Multiple test customers created with portal_enabled=True
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal Documents feature is fully working. AI Business Assistant returns context-aware responses with actual shop data. Portal login page has correct layout (Sign In + Register tabs only). Send-to-portal endpoint had a bug that was fixed (null check for tenant).

send_to_portal_500_error.root_cause: In documents.py line 589, when notify_customer is True and customer has email, code tries to call tenant.get('portal_url', ...) but tenant can be None if not found in database
send_to_portal_500_error.fix: Added conditional check: portal_url = tenant.get('portal_url', 'https://signguy.ai/customer-portal') if tenant else 'https://signguy.ai/customer-portal'
send_to_portal_500_error.verification: Test now passes - document sent to portal successfully
